brief.headline: 11,798 predicted passes within 5 km of a Starlink satellite in the next 24 hours, 460 of them within 1 km.
lines: Closest: STARLINK-6032 and DUTHSAT-2 (Greece, satellite), predicted 74 m apart at 22:23 UTC, closing at 10.2 km/s.
Most passes: China (3,313) and United States (3,051); per object, 2.59 and 2.61.
2,180 passes involve rocket bodies or debris; China owns the most of that hardware.
Objects with no registered owner: 5.20 passes each, across 158 objects.
Over 38.8 days, 0% of ISS satellites in Starlink's band were seen maneuvering.
Screened 11,191 Starlinks against 4,615 objects from public data. Screening grade, not collision probabilities.
